descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - through Indianapolis.

YOUR GARAGE
Start in a luxury three-car garage with a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts.

TWO RACE CARS
Choose your car in the garage: the blue-interior race car with a deep-dish suede wheel and a billet shift knob, or the red-interior original. Both have a V12, a race cockpit, bucket seats, shift lights and a live display.

DRIVE WITH YOUR HANDS
Grip the wheel, work the gear stick and pull the handbrake with your controllers - or put them down and drive with your bare hands.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Rev it to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.

21 MILES OF REAL INDIANAPOLIS
The I-70 past the airport and Mars Hill into downtown and the stadium, through the south split, the I-65 south past Fountain Square and Garfield Park, then the I-465 beltway round the south side over the White River and home.

ROAD EVENTS
Seven events from the Skyline Cruise to the Full Loop. Race for gold - your best run comes back as a ghost car.

SPEED TRAPS AND RUSH HOUR
Six speed cameras record your top speed in mph. In Rush Hour on the I-70, close passes build your combo.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden hour over the White River, a bright Indiana day, or the city lights after dark.

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
Menus in English and Spanish, US road signs, mph.

Plus paints, achievements, ranks, a map with quick travel and an original radio soundtrack.
